body.x: The Consumer Technology Association (CTA)® today announced the exhibitor lineup and new speakers for CES Unveiled in Amsterdam. CES Unveiled is an official CES 2020 preview event, focusing on the theme “Tech Improving Lives.”

An expected 100 exhibitors (including 50+ startups) from the Netherlands and across Europe are set to showcase the latest in tech innovation. Attendees will have the opportunity to touch, feel and interact with the latest innovations in artificial intelligence, mobility, resilience, sustainability and smart cities. Some top exhibitors include:
20tree.ai - Protects the earth’s forests by providing data-driven actionable planet intelligence
Coolfinity – Creates fridges that only need 6 hours of power per day
Hydraloop - Inspires people to save energy by offering smart and affordable water recycling products
LeydenJar Technologies - Increases energy density of Li-ion battery cells for electronics, electric vehicles, and residential energy storage
Meatable – Makes 100% real, delicious, guilt-free meat from one cell
meds2go – Creates containers for temperature-sensitive medicines
Nextérité – Provides real-time mobility and transport information services via semantic and AI algorithms
Skoon – Provides clean energy on demand
Urban Mobility Systems – Produces practical solutions that enable full-electric transport of people and goods
Vispero – Offers assistive technology for visually impaired
This year’s event will provide a conference track on “Tech Improving Lives,” as well as matchmaking and investor events for startups and executives. Announced speakers include:
HRH Prince Constantijn van Oranje, Special Envoy at TechLeap.NL
Mona Keijzer, Netherlands State Secretary for Economic Affairs and Climate Policy
Pete Hoekstra, U.S. Ambassador to the Netherlands
NEW - Femke Halsema, Mayor of Amsterdam
Gary Shapiro, president and CEO, CTA
Karen Chupka, EVP, CES
Steve Koenig, VP of market research, CTA
NEW – Gillian Tans, Chairwoman, Booking.com
NEW – Corinne Vigreux, co-founder of TomTom and founder of CODAM
NEW - Babak Fouladi, Chief Technology and Digital Officer, KPN
NEW – Dr. Andreas Olmes, Partner and Investment Director, High-Tech Gründerfonds

CES Unveiled in Amsterdam has partnered with Brainport Network, CFO.Community, Corporate Venturing Network, EU Commission, futurefactor, Ministry of Economic Affairs and Climate Policy, NL Chamber of Commerce, TechLeap.NL, TomTom and TradeCounsellors to offer attendees an intriguing slate of co-located events throughout day and in addition to conference programming.

Returning for its third year, CES Unveiled in Amsterdam will bring together government leaders, executives, influential media, prominent industry influencers, and more than 100 companies (including 50+ startups) to explore the latest technology trends and innovations from the Netherlands and surrounding European countries leading up to CES® 2020. Attendees and media are able to register for CES Unveiled in Amsterdam online.
